name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
department: Ministry of Education – Department of Higher Education
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for students who scored above the 80th percentile in their Class XII board stream, pursuing regular (non-distance) college or university courses.
eligibility_text: Above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream of your Class XII board; regular course (not correspondence/distance); family income up to ₹4.5 lakh per annum; not receiving any other scholarship or fee reimbursement. Diploma students are not eligible (per 2022-23 FAQ).
amount_text: ₹12,000 per year for the first three years of graduation; ₹20,000 per year at postgraduation (and 4th/5th year of technical courses).
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer to bank account.
documents: Income certificate (fresh applicants), Class XII marksheet, bank account details, Aadhaar (Aadhaar seeding is required for payment). Confirm full list on NSP.
verification_note: Income limit, amount and conditions confirmed from Ministry of Education guidelines/FAQ 2025-26. Scheme-specific 2026-27 deadline not confirmed – NSP general student deadline is 31-10-2026; check NSP for any extension.

rules.message: Only for college/university (UG/PG) students; diploma students are excluded.
Family income must be up to ₹4.5 lakh per annum.
You must not be receiving any other scholarship or fee reimbursement.
Verify you are above the 80th percentile in your Class XII board stream (a percentile, not a raw percentage, so it cannot be computed from marks).
Confirm your course is regular (not distance/correspondence).

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
description: Supports girl students in AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma programmes.
eligibility_text: Girl students admitted to the first year of an AICTE-approved degree/diploma (or second year via lateral entry); family income up to ₹8 lakh per annum; maximum two girl children per family.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer to the student's bank account.
documents: Valid family income certificate from the competent State/UT authority; other documents per NSP checklist.
verification_note: Rules from AICTE scheme document. 2026-27 dates reported on NSP-based sources (secondary); confirm on NSP.

rules.message: Only for girl students.
Only for technical diploma or degree students.
Only for first-year admission (or second year via lateral entry).
Family income must be up to ₹8 lakh per annum.
Your college/course must be AICTE-approved.
Only two girl children per family can benefit – confirm this applies to you.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students
description: Supports students with disabilities in AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma programmes.
eligibility_text: Disability of at least 40%; admitted to first year of an AICTE-approved degree/diploma (or second year via lateral entry); family income up to ₹8 lakh per annum.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer to the student's bank account.
documents: Disability certificate, family income certificate from State/UT authority; others per NSP checklist.
verification_note: Rules from AICTE/myScheme; 2026-27 dates from NSP-based secondary sources.

rules.message: Requires a disability of at least 40%.
Only for technical diploma or degree students.
Only for first-year admission (or second year via lateral entry).
Family income must be up to ₹8 lakh per annum.
Your college/course must be AICTE-approved.

name: PM YASASVI – Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Post-matric scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT students, routed through State/UT governments.
eligibility_text: OBC, EBC or DNT student (as notified); studying after Class 10; family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per annum.
amount_text: Varies by course group – exact rates not confirmed in this build; see the official guidelines.
benefits: Academic allowance and tuition fee support (see guidelines).
documents: Income certificate, caste certificate, marksheets, bank details (confirm on NSP).
verification_note: Income limit confirmed on myScheme/PIB. Deadline reported by secondary sources; amount not confirmed.

rules.message: Only for OBC/EBC/DNT students, not SC/ST.
Only OBC is confirmed from your profile. EBC/DNT status depends on your state's notification – verify.
Only for post-matric (after Class 10) courses.
Family income must be up to ₹2.5 lakh per annum.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Covers fees and maintenance allowance for SC students pursuing post-matric courses.
eligibility_text: SC student studying after Class 10. Income ceiling was ₹2.5 lakh per annum through 2025-26; a revision for 2026-27 onwards has been under consideration.
amount_text: Not verified – rates vary by course group; see NSP guidelines.
benefits: Course fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance.
documents: Caste certificate, income certificate, marksheets, bank details.
verification_note: ₹2.5 lakh ceiling confirmed up to 2025-26; whether it changed for 2026-27 could not be confirmed. Deadline not confirmed.

rules.message: Only for Scheduled Caste students.
Only for post-matric courses.
Family income must be up to ₹2.5 lakh per annum (limit may have been revised).

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students
eligibility_text: ST student studying after Class 10; parental income ceiling reported as ₹2.5 lakh, with a proposal to raise it to ₹4.5 lakh.
documents: Caste certificate, income certificate, marksheets, bank details.
verification_note: Income limit from secondary sources; a revision to ₹4.5 lakh was proposed. Confirm on NSP.

rules.message: Only for Scheduled Tribe students.
Only for post-matric courses.
Family income must be within the limit (₹2.5 lakh reported; may be revised).

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Post-matric support for students with benchmark disability.
eligibility_text: Benchmark disability (40% or above); Class 11 onwards including diploma, UG, PG; family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per annum.
documents: Disability certificate, income certificate, marksheets, bank details.
verification_note: Criteria from a secondary NSP summary only; confirm on NSP.

rules.message: Requires a benchmark disability of at least 40%.
Only for Class 11 onwards.
Family income must be up to ₹2.5 lakh per annum.

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses (Minorities)
description: For minority students in professional/technical UG and PG courses. 30% of scholarships are earmarked for girls.
eligibility_text: Belong to a notified minority community; at least 50% marks in the previous exam; admitted to a professional/technical course; family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per annum; no other scholarship.
amount_text: Course fee up to ₹20,000 per year (per myScheme); maintenance allowance details not verified.
verification_note: Union Budget 2026-27 reportedly cut this scheme's outlay to almost nil; confirm that it is accepting applications.

rules.message: Only for notified minority communities.
Only for UG/PG professional courses.
Only for professional/technical courses.
Family income must be up to ₹2.5 lakh per annum.
At least 50% marks in the previous exam.
You must not be availing another scholarship.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
department: Ministry of Education – Dept of School Education & Literacy
description: For selected meritorious students from economically weaker sections to reduce dropout after Class 8.
eligibility_text: Selection through a state-level exam for Class 9; income limit not confirmed here.
verification_note: Amount confirmed by PIB. Deadline was extended more than once and sources conflict – check NSP. Income limit not verified.

rules.message: For school students (Class 9–12) only.
Only students selected through the state-level selection test can apply.

name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme)
department: Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Monthly assistance for girls from government schools who enrol in higher education.
eligibility_text: Tamil Nadu girl students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in government schools (extended to government-aided schools); pursuing UG degree/diploma/ITI or other recognised course. Applications are routed through the institution.
benefits: Direct credit to bank account until course completion.
documents: School study certificates (Class 6–12), bank details, mobile number.
verification_note: Benefit and school-study condition from TN government pages; no income limit found. Dates not published in sources – confirm with your college.

rules.message: Only for Tamil Nadu students.
Only for girl students.
Must have studied Classes 6–12 in government (or government-aided) schools.
Only for diploma/UG courses (per sources reviewed).

name: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme
description: Monthly assistance for boys from government/government-aided schools pursuing higher education.
eligibility_text: Tamil Nadu boys who studied Classes 6–12 in government or government-aided schools; full conditions not fully confirmed.
verification_note: Verified from news coverage and a college notice only; official portal not found. Apply link unavailable.

rules.message: Only for Tamil Nadu students.
Only for boys.
Must have studied Classes 6–12 in government/government-aided schools.
Only for UG/diploma courses.
